div.head: Ine 46.2
div.ab: Ælc mon mot onsacan fyrmðe ⁊ werfæhþe, gif he mæg oððe dearr.
Ælc mon mot onsacan frymþe ⁊ werfæhðe, gif he mæg oððe dear.
Omni homini licet firmationem et werefactionem negare, si possit uel audet (et uelit).
Ælc mon mot onsacan frymþe ⁊ werfæhðe, gif he mæg oððe déar.
Every person may clear himself of instigating [wrongdoing] or an act of violence requiring payment of wergild, if he is able or dares to.
Every man may clear himself from the charge of harbouring [stolen goods] or of homicide, if he can and dare do so.
Every man may deny by oath harbouring [of stolen goods?] and homicide, if he can and dare.
Jedermann darf sich frei schwören von [Diebstahls-]Beherbergung und Menschen-Tödtung, wenn er kann oder wagt.
Everyone may swear himself free of harbouring [theft] and of homicide, if he can or dares.

note.label: same term
note.quote: This word is used only here and in §57.
